svg.title: Processing PII with Presidio: AWS deployment
svg.desc: Harness builds one Docker image, pushes it to ECR and deploys one ECS service per feed. Each worker reads its feed's Solace input queue over a native TLS connection with parallel consumers, masks PII with Presidio in the same process, and publishes masked messages to a topic whose output queue serves downstream consumers. Failed messages go to the feed's restricted dead letter queue, with a broker backstop. Services scale automatically and are pre-scaled before holidays.
svg.text: Processing PII with Presidio · AWS deployment

g.text: Confirm with team: CI · ECR · ECS

svg.text: AWS · ECS Fargate · one service per feed
Minimum sized for the normal peak.
Rejected messages go to the feed's DLQ.
The broker moves stuck messages as a backstop.
Raw PII never goes to output.
Input, output and dead letter queues.
No AWS API calls from the worker.
